title: CNN, Feynman and the Challenger disaster
summary: A June 1986 CNN interview with physicist Richard Feynman about the Challenger disaster and the management failures he found while serving on the investigating commission.
why: HN cites it for Feynman's insights on NASA risk reasoning, blame and engineering culture, and the contrast between Apollo and the Shuttle.

quote.text: Richard Feynman served on the Challenger commission and very nicely summarizes the difference between Apollo and Space Shuttle.
